---
name: New skill
about: Propose a skill that is not already in the v0.1 list
title: "[skill] "
---

## Name

Folder name: lowercase, digits, hyphens, matching `SKILL.md` `name`.

## What it checks or builds

One paragraph. Say what it will not do (no portal filing, no live payment capture, no legal advice).

## Primary sources

Links you have opened, with the date you opened them. Mark anything you have not opened as UNVERIFIED.

## Rules file

Which `rules/<domain>.json` keys this skill would add. Do not overwrite another skill's keys.

## Test vectors

At least one positive and one negative case. IDs must be synthetic, except the public GSTINs already listed in SPEC §1.1.
